summary: The audit checks the 45 graduate units, all taken for a letter grade, and at least three advanced FRENCH courses numbered 200 or above. Apart from the one cultural history course, every unit toward the 45 must be an advanced French literature course, so other courses do not count toward the 45. You or an advisor check by hand the one cultural history course (from any department), which three FRENCH courses cover the pre-revolutionary period, the 3.3 GPA and the master's written and oral examination.
